# Tollgate Weir

From Openpedia, the free encyclopedia

Tollgate Weir

| Location | River Alder, Brindle Valley |
| --- | --- |
| Built | 1894 |
| Height | 1.1 m |
| Status | Retained as fish counter |

**Tollgate Weir** is a low stone weir on the River Alder. It is the only weir on the river that was kept after the 2019–2023 removals.

## History

The weir was built in 1894 to feed a corn mill that closed in 1931. Its sluice gate was welded open in 1966.

## Fish counter

A resistivity counter was installed in 2022. It records fish by size class and direction of travel.
